description: This file defines the API interface for a directory change notification system, enabling code to subscribe and react to changes in the current working directory. It includes function prototypes for registering, unregistering, reparenting paths, and performing directory change operations, along with detailed comments explaining usage.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the directory changes.

methods.name: chdir_notify_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered directory change callback.

methods.name: chdir_notify_reparent
methods.description: Updates the relative path to account for directory reparenting.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes the current working directory and notifies registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from one directory to another, returning a new string.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
